verdict.rationale: LightSprint documents showing reviewers a plain-English summary plus the actual diff, along with screenshots and video, so the team can review changes before approving them. It also logs who proposed, reviewed and approved each change. However, its documented review and merge surface (Review Hub) operates on pull requests that already exist, and no evidence shows the approval gate sits before PR creation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that diff approval happens before a PR is opened, details of the diff-review UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review a diff of an agent's changes and approve it before it becomes a pull request
